objective: Find every audit that verifies a surface by re-deriving it through the same function that wrote it
rationale: The wall credential check re-derives each card through the same display function that wrote the published card, so an error inside that function is identical on both sides and reads as agreement. Measured 2026-08-01: the Ahmed 25 degree row published its value on frontal area and its band on planform area, understating the band by the whole 3.586 area ratio, and the check reported PASS before the fix and PASS after it. What the check measures is drift between the surface and the code, which is worth measuring and is not the same thing as the surface being right. Other checks in the audit are likely built the same way, and each one should say which of the two it is testing.
citations: The self audit's wall credentials check
The credential display re-derivation used by the wall builder
cost_basis: estimate; reading the audit's own checks, no solver
expected_knowledge_gain: Each audit states whether it tests a surface against its generator or against evidence, so a check nobody can fail is visible as one
outcome: Swept, and the premise holds but is narrower than filed in one direction and worse in another. All 27 checks in scripts/self_audit.py were read and each now declares, in a BASIS table the audit itself enforces, which of five things it tests, what it catches and what it is blind to. The tally over the 29 checks that now exist: 9 EVIDENCE (re-derive a published number from a primary artifact by arithmetic the audit performs itself), 11 PROPERTY, 4 SURFACE, 2 GENERATOR, 1 TRANSCRIBED, 2 META. THREE OF 29 CANNOT FAIL ON A DEFECT IN THE CODE OR CONSTANTS THEY CHECK. (1) check_wall_credentials_vs_results, the one this item was filed on: it calls chief_engineer.lab.displayed_credential at self_audit.py:696 and sdk/scripts/build_wall.py calls the same function at line 83 to write the card, so the Ahmed 25 degree area-basis defect was on both sides and it read PASS before the fix and PASS after. One arm of it IS independent: relative_error is recomputed there from the result file's own cd_compared and reference_cd. (2) check_gate_table_vs_transcripts imports scripts/gate_table.py and compares its fresh output to the published NINE_ACT_GATE_TABLE.md, which is that same generator's output pasted into markdown; it catches drift and a transcript that stopped supporting a row, and a misparse inside gate_table.py agrees with itself. (3) The worst is check_cost_predictions, which the filing did not name: its entire evidence is three tuples typed into the audit file, so it reads nothing on disk and cannot fail on a wrong pair at all, while 26 of the 57 completed docket items state a measured core-minute figure in their outcome and none is in that list. Nine checks are genuinely independent and the shape to copy is check_f2_reproduction, which parses postProcessing/forceCoeffs1/0/coefficient.dat itself. Three more carry couplings that are real but not of this kind and are now stated: check_memory_scaling_law refits the law correctly and reads its three measurements out of the same document that states the law, so a mistyped MiB figure refits to the mistyped law; check_fd_grades_current_standard reads the percentage off the published row and never recomputes it, and its _fd_grade restates verification charter section 7 as literals; check_declined_ladders_name_their_guard compares two fields the same writer wrote from the same fit and never refits to confirm either. FOUND ON THE WAY, and left as an open finding: THE AUDIT DOES NOT AUDIT ITSELF. _py_sources() covers sdk/workflows and sdk/chief_engineer only, so scripts/ is outside the reach of check_restated_thresholds, and self_audit.py's own two restated constants, _fd_grade's 15.0/5.0 and STALL_SECONDS, are invisible to the check that exists to find exactly that. Two checks added. check_every_check_states_its_basis enforces the declaration mechanically rather than as a comment: a GENERATOR entry must name the symbol it shares with the producer and that symbol must appear in both files, so a coupling removed or a declaration never true is a finding. check_stored_fits_reproduce_their_values closes the gap the old study check left: it compared key sets and never values, so a stale or hand-typed number under a present key passed. All 110 stored values across the 8 refittable studies reproduce exactly from their own rungs at zero compute; aortic-valve stores 3 rungs that no current fit reproduces and is now named on the report rather than being invisible, which matters because its conclusive:True is a typed literal and its band is the only one in the corpus reaching a live certificate. Commit 443f9eac. Zero compute against a zero estimate.
